additional_info.subject: Case opening remark
additional_info.body:
An attempt was made to change the OCPP parameter TxStopPoint from "EnergyTransfer" to "PowerPatchClosed."
The control unit reports "Configuration change in the control unit rejected."
The change should be made directly via the Chargecloud backend; the parameter has the status "changeable."

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0412978-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP / P2 170000123] OCPP parameter change request CRM:00643001354
additional_info.body:
Hi Grun,
Could you please confirm whether the TxStopPoint you’re mentioning refers to the StopTransaction.req as per the OCPP 1.6J protocol, which includes MeterStop (containing the meter value in Wh for the connector at the end of the transaction)? Or are you referring to MeterValues.req as per the OCPP 1.6J protocol, which includes sampled meter values with timestamps? Please share a snapshot showing where the changes are being rejected, and note that this should be done via the Chargecloud backend.
Awaiting your feedback
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Shrey

the
subject of this Email when
replying
to it.
